choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: no preregistration or primary designation is reported, and the abstract/introduction present both total-idea variation and image-level homogenization without prioritizing either. They are different outcomes, neither supports a participant-level standardized contrast, and neither differs from the other by repeated session, AI arm, or subgroup restriction.
choices.locator: PDF p. 1, Abstract; pp. 1-2, Section 1; pp. 6-8, Sections 4.2.2-4.2.3 and Figure 5; p. 11, Section 5.1 (quoted passage).
choices.quote: the AI condition initially produced a broader design space at the group level at total idea level. However, in contrast to this, the final directions selected for exploration at the image level demonstrated a homogenization effect.
